name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
summary: A fly performed on a slight incline to bias the upper chest through a long stretch.
setup: Set the bench to about 30 degrees.
Sit with light dumbbells on your thighs, lie back and press them above the chest, palms facing each other.
Pull shoulder blades back and down, feet planted.
Slightly bend the elbows and keep that angle.
execution: Lower the dumbbells in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep the elbow bend fixed and wrists neutral.
Squeeze the chest to bring the dumbbells back over the upper chest.
Lower the weights carefully to your thighs when finished.
mistakes: Dumbbells too heavy: reduce load and use full control.
Bench too steep: stay near 30 degrees so the chest is still involved.
Dropping the arms too low: stop at a comfortable stretch.
Turning it into a press by bending the elbows more: keep the angle constant.
